## Your Task
Write the Elm test suite for the foundation of the elm-naive-ui library.

CONTEXT — READ FIRST (all in /home/titan/Works/elm/elm-naive-ui):
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- src/NUI/Theme.elm, src/NUI/Theme/Common.elm, src/NUI/Theme/Color.elm
- src/NUI/Internal.elm, src/NUI/Css.elm, src/NUI/Types.elm
- src/NUI/Button.elm (already implemented — test it)
- src/NUI/Theme/Button.elm (generated vars)

DELIVERABLE: a runnable test suite in `tests/`.

Environment constraints (important):
- `elm-test` is NOT installed and may not be installable. Prefer a **self-contained Elm
  application** in `tests/` with its own `elm.json` (type "application", `source-directories:
  ["src", "../src"]`, deps: elm/core, elm/html, elm/json, mdgriffith/elm-ui). Then a
  `tests/src/Main.elm` that evaluates a list of named assertions and renders the results
  as HTML (e.g. one line per test: `PASS name` / `FAIL name — expected … got …`, plus a
  total count and a `data-failures="N"` attribute on a container element).
- Build it with: `cd tests && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html`
  (this must succeed).
- Run/inspect it with jsdom (does NOT need a browser):
  `node ../tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs index.html '[data-test]'` — or a small script of
  your own using the already-installed jsdom at ../tools/verify/node_modules. Have the page
  expose a machine-readable result (e.g. `window.__results = […]` or a DOM node with all
  results) and a script that exits non-zero on failure.
- If elm-explorations/test turns out to be installable you may use elm-test instead, but do
  not block on it.

TESTS TO WRITE (assert real, meaningful behaviour):
1. `NUI.Theme`: `default`/`dark` modes and common values; `setPrimary` sets
   `primaryColor`/`Hover`/`Pressed`/`Suppl` consistently; `withCommon` composition.
2. `NUI.Theme.Color`: ported `seemly` behaviour — `createHoverColor "#666666"` must equal
   `"rgba(126, 126, 126)"`, `createHoverColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)"` must equal
   `"rgba(76, 165, 146)"`, `createPressedColor "#666666"` must equal `"rgba(90, 90, 90)"`.
   (These are the exact values seemly/Naive UI produce.) Also test `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`,
   `rgb()`, `rgba()` parsing and `changeColor`.
3. `NUI.Internal.cssVars`: `initial` values and empty values are dropped; ordering/labels
   are `k:v` joined with `;`.
4. `NUI.Theme.Button.vars`: a few known values for the default (light) theme — e.g.
   `heightMedium == "34px"`, `paddingMedium == "0 14px"`, `fontSizeMedium == "14px"`,
   `borderRadiusMedium == "3px"`, `color == "#0000"`, and that dark mode differs
   (`waveOpacity == "0.8"`). Also assert a common-derived field tracks `setPrimary`
   (e.g. `textColorGhostPrimary` changes when the primary colour changes).
5. `NUI.Button`: drive `view`, convert the result to HTML with `Element.toUnstyled`? — if
   that is unavailable, instead expose/verify the pure helpers: at minimum assert that the
   `--n-*` var list for representative option combinations contains the expected entries
   (kind Primary → `--n-color` equals the primary colour; `disabled` → the disabled state;
   `round` → border-radius equals the height). Refactor `NUI.Button` minimally (it is your
   allowed edit target for this task) ONLY if needed to export the cssVars computation for
   testing — keep the public API unchanged. Prefer adding a thin exported helper like
   `cssVarsFor : Theme -> Options msg -> List (String, String)`.
6. `NUI.Css.css`: contains `.n-button`, is scoped (contains `.nui-root.nui-root`), and
   contains the bridge rule for `flex-basis`.

CONSTRAINTS:
- You may edit ONLY files under `tests/`, plus (if strictly required) export helpers from
  `src/NUI/Button.elm`. Do NOT touch generated files (src/NUI/Theme/*, src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm),
  tools/bridge.css, elm.json, or other components — other agents are editing those.
- Add a `tests/run.sh` that builds and runs the suite and exits non-zero on failure.

REPORT: the exact command to run the suite, how many assertions, and what passed/failed.

# Architecture & conventions

`elm-naive-ui` rebuilds [Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components on top of
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/), aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original.

## How fidelity is achieved

Naive UI styles a component from two inputs:

1. **Static structure CSS** — BEM rules like `.n-button { display:inline-flex; … }`,
   including `:hover` / `:focus` / `:active` / `:disabled` states and transitions.
2. **Themed values** — inline `--n-*` CSS custom properties, derived from the theme
   (`self(commonVars)` in Naive UI).

This project reproduces both, so what the browser renders is Naive UI's own CSS:

- `css/naive-ui.css` (and the embedded `NUI.Css.Generated`) contains Naive UI's **exact**
  CSS, generated from its `cssr` sources by `tools/` — not hand-written.
- Each component attaches the same BEM classes **and** an inline `style` carrying the
  same `--n-*` custom properties, computed in Elm from `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars`.

### Beating elm-ui's own classes

elm-ui renders elements with helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, `.ui`, `.hc`, …) that
declare `display`, `flex-direction`, `flex-basis`, `white-space`, `padding`, `color`, …
This would fight Naive UI's rules. Two mechanisms resolve it:

- Every generated Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root ` (two identical
  class selectors) so it always out-specifies elm-ui's class rules. The app root must
  therefore carry the `nui-root` class — `NUI.Css.layout` adds it, and `NUI.Css.element`
  renders the stylesheet node.
- `tools/bridge.css` restores browser defaults for the two properties Naive UI does
  **not** declare but elm-ui changes: `flex-basis` and `white-space`.

**Do not edit `css/naive-ui.css`, `src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm`, or `tools/bridge.css`
per-component.** If a component needs an extra bridge rule, note it in the PR/task
summary so it can be added centrally.

## Module layout

```
src/
  NUI/Types.elm            Kind, Size (public enums) + kindClass/sizeClass
  NUI/Internal.elm         classes / classIf / cssVars helpers
  NUI/Css.elm              stylesheet + `layout` / `rootAttribute`
  NUI/Css/Generated.elm    GENERATED — do not edit
  NUI/Theme.elm            Theme = { mode, common }, default/dark/setPrimary
  NUI/Theme/Common.elm     GENERATED — common vars (light/dark)
  NUI/Theme/<Comp>.elm     GENERATED — component vars: `vars : Theme -> Vars`
  NUI/<Comp>.elm           the component
```

Generated theme modules map each component variable either to a `common` field (so theme
overrides propagate) or to a literal. Regenerate everything with `cd tools && npm run extract`.

## Component conventions

Model each component on `src/NUI/Button.elm`.

- **API**: an `Options msg` record plus `defaults : Options msg` and
  `view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg`.

  ```elm
  NUI.Button.view theme { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = T.Primary } [ Element.text "Ok" ]
  ```

- **Theme vars**: `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars theme` gives the component's `Vars`; read the
  exact fields Naive UI's `cssVars` uses. Port that logic faithfully from
  `src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx` (`cssVarsRef`) — do not invent values.
- **Classes**: copy the class list from the original `render()` (e.g.
  `.n-button--{size}-type`), including ones not present in the CSS — they cost nothing
  and keep parity with other components / button groups.
- **Root element**: use `Element.row` for row-like roots (Naive UI sets `display` itself,
  which wins; `flex-direction: row` then comes from elm-ui) — see `NUI.Button`. Use
  `Element.el` only when a column root is intended.
- **Attach** `NUI.Internal.classes [...]` and `NUI.Internal.cssVars [...]` (the latter
  drops `initial` values, matching Naive UI's "unset" marker).
- **Interactive elements**: `onPress : Maybe msg` → add `role="button"`, `tabindex 0`
  and `Element.Events.onClick`. Naive UI uses a real `<button>`; a styled `<div>` renders
  identically because `.n-button` sets all button-reset properties itself.
- **Icons**: render Naive UI's `__icon` / `__border` / `__state-border` wrapper elements
  so the CSS applies.

## Reference source (read-only)

The Naive UI checkout is at `/home/titan/Works/elm/naive-ui` (override with
`NAIVE_UI_SRC`). Per component:

```
src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx          implementation + cssVars
src/<comp>/src/styles/*.cssr.ts    structure CSS (already extracted)
src/<comp>/styles/light.ts         theme var derivations (`self`)
src/<comp>/src/public-types.ts     props
src/<comp>/demos/enUS/*.md         usage examples
```

## Building & verifying

```bash
# library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# example page
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html

# DOM/style inspection (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
node tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs examples/index.html .n-button
```

`ELM_HOME` must point at a directory with the packages pre-installed; see
`scripts/install-elm-packages.sh` (github.com is blocked in this sandbox; packages are
fetched from `codeload.github.com`).

message.content:
# Architecture & conventions

`elm-naive-ui` rebuilds [Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components on top of
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/), aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original.

## How fidelity is achieved

Naive UI styles a component from two inputs:

1. **Static structure CSS** — BEM rules like `.n-button { display:inline-flex; … }`,
   including `:hover` / `:focus` / `:active` / `:disabled` states and transitions.
2. **Themed values** — inline `--n-*` CSS custom properties, derived from the theme
   (`self(commonVars)` in Naive UI).

This project reproduces both, so what the browser renders is Naive UI's own CSS:

- `css/naive-ui.css` (and the embedded `NUI.Css.Generated`) contains Naive UI's **exact**
  CSS, generated from its `cssr` sources by `tools/` — not hand-written.
- Each component attaches the same BEM classes **and** an inline `style` carrying the
  same `--n-*` custom properties, computed in Elm from `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars`.

### Beating elm-ui's own classes

elm-ui renders elements with helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, `.ui`, `.hc`, …) that
declare `display`, `flex-direction`, `flex-basis`, `white-space`, `padding`, `color`, …
This would fight Naive UI's rules. Two mechanisms resolve it:

- Every generated Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root ` (two identical
  class selectors) so it always out-specifies elm-ui's class rules. The app root must
  therefore carry the `nui-root` class — `NUI.Css.layout` adds it, and `NUI.Css.element`
  renders the stylesheet node.
- `tools/bridge.css` restores browser defaults for the two properties Naive UI does
  **not** declare but elm-ui changes: `flex-basis` and `white-space`.

**Do not edit `css/naive-ui.css`, `src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm`, or `tools/bridge.css`
per-component.** If a component needs an extra bridge rule, note it in the PR/task
summary so it can be added centrally.

## Module layout

```
src/
  NUI/Types.elm            Kind, Size (public enums) + kindClass/sizeClass
  NUI/Internal.elm         classes / classIf / cssVars helpers
  NUI/Css.elm              stylesheet + `layout` / `rootAttribute`
  NUI/Css/Generated.elm    GENERATED — do not edit
  NUI/Theme.elm            Theme = { mode, common }, default/dark/setPrimary
  NUI/Theme/Common.elm     GENERATED — common vars (light/dark)
  NUI/Theme/<Comp>.elm     GENERATED — component vars: `vars : Theme -> Vars`
  NUI/<Comp>.elm           the component
```

Generated theme modules map each component variable either to a `common` field (so theme
overrides propagate) or to a literal. Regenerate everything with `cd tools && npm run extract`.

## Component conventions

Model each component on `src/NUI/Button.elm`.

- **API**: an `Options msg` record plus `defaults : Options msg` and
  `view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg`.

  ```elm
  NUI.Button.view theme { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = T.Primary } [ Element.text "Ok" ]
  ```

- **Theme vars**: `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars theme` gives the component's `Vars`; read the
  exact fields Naive UI's `cssVars` uses. Port that logic faithfully from
  `src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx` (`cssVarsRef`) — do not invent values.
- **Classes**: copy the class list from the original `render()` (e.g.
  `.n-button--{size}-type`), including ones not present in the CSS — they cost nothing
  and keep parity with other components / button groups.
- **Root element**: use `Element.row` for row-like roots (Naive UI sets `display` itself,
  which wins; `flex-direction: row` then comes from elm-ui) — see `NUI.Button`. Use
  `Element.el` only when a column root is intended.
- **Attach** `NUI.Internal.classes [...]` and `NUI.Internal.cssVars [...]` (the latter
  drops `initial` values, matching Naive UI's "unset" marker).
- **Interactive elements**: `onPress : Maybe msg` → add `role="button"`, `tabindex 0`
  and `Element.Events.onClick`. Naive UI uses a real `<button>`; a styled `<div>` renders
  identically because `.n-button` sets all button-reset properties itself.
- **Icons**: render Naive UI's `__icon` / `__border` / `__state-border` wrapper elements
  so the CSS applies.

## Reference source (read-only)

The Naive UI checkout is at `/home/titan/Works/elm/naive-ui` (override with
`NAIVE_UI_SRC`). Per component:

```
src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx          implementation + cssVars
src/<comp>/src/styles/*.cssr.ts    structure CSS (already extracted)
src/<comp>/styles/light.ts         theme var derivations (`self`)
src/<comp>/src/public-types.ts     props
src/<comp>/demos/enUS/*.md         usage examples
```

## Building & verifying

```bash
# library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# example page
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html

# DOM/style inspection (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
node tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs examples/index.html .n-button
```

`ELM_HOME` must point at a directory with the packages pre-installed; see
`scripts/install-elm-packages.sh` (github.com is blocked in this sandbox; packages are
fetched from `codeload.github.com`).

module NUI.Theme exposing
    ( Mode(..)
    , Theme
    , dark
    , default
    , light
    , setPrimary
    , withCommon
    , withMode
    )

{-| The theme is Naive UI's "common" variable set plus a mode flag. Component
themes are derived from it (exactly like Naive UI's `self(vars)`).
-}

import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Theme.Common as Common exposing (Common)


type Mode
    = Light
    | Dark


type alias Theme =
    { mode : Mode
    , common : Common
    }


light : Theme
light =
    { mode = Light, common = Common.light }


dark : Theme
dark =
    { mode = Dark, common = Common.dark }


default : Theme
default =
    light


withMode : Mode -> Theme -> Theme
withMode mode theme =
    case mode of
        Light ->
            { theme | mode = Light, common = Common.light }

        Dark ->
            { theme | mode = Dark, common = Common.dark }


{-| Escape hatch: tweak the raw common variables.
-}
withCommon : (Common -> Common) -> Theme -> Theme
withCommon f theme =
    { theme | common = f theme.common }


{-| Override the primary colour family, deriving hover / pressed / suppl like Naive UI.
-}
setPrimary : String -> Theme -> Theme
setPrimary color theme =
    withCommon
        (\c ->
            { c
                | primaryColor = color
                , primaryColorHover = Color.createHoverColor color
                , primaryColorPressed = Color.createPressedColor color
                , primaryColorSuppl = Color.createHoverColor color
            }
        )
        theme

module NUI.Theme.Color exposing
    ( Rgba
    , changeColor
    , composite
    , createHoverColor
    , createPressedColor
    , parse
    , toCss
    )

{-| Minimal colour maths ported from `seemly` (the library Naive UI uses), so that
runtime colour derivations match Naive UI exactly.
-}


type alias Rgba =
    { r : Float
    , g : Float
    , b : Float
    , a : Float
    }


{-| Parse `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `rgb(r, g, b)` and `rgba(r, g, b, a)`.
-}
parse : String -> Maybe Rgba
parse raw =
    let
        s =
            String.trim (String.toLower raw)
    in
    if String.startsWith "#" s then
        parseHex (String.dropLeft 1 s)

    else if String.startsWith "rgba(" s then
        parseFn 4 s

    else if String.startsWith "rgb(" s then
        parseFn 3 s

    else
        Nothing


parseHex : String -> Maybe Rgba
parseHex hex =
    let
        expand c =
            String.toList c |> List.map (\ch -> String.fromChar ch) |> List.map (\ch -> ch ++ ch) |> String.concat

        pairs body =
            chunksOf 2 body
    in
    case String.length hex of
        3 ->
            pairs (expand hex) |> hexParts

        6 ->
            pairs hex |> hexParts

        _ ->
            Nothing


chunksOf : Int -> String -> List String
chunksOf n s =
    if String.isEmpty s then
        []

    else
        String.left n s :: chunksOf n (String.dropLeft n s)


hexParts : List String -> Maybe Rgba
hexParts ps =
    case List.map (\p -> String.toInt ("0x" ++ p)) ps of
        [ Just r, Just g, Just b ] ->
            Just { r = toFloat r, g = toFloat g, b = toFloat b, a = 1 }

        _ ->
            Nothing


parseFn : Int -> String -> Maybe Rgba
parseFn arity s =
    let
        body =
            s |> String.dropLeft (arity + 1) |> String.dropRight 1 |> String.replace "/" " "

        parts =
            body |> String.split "," |> List.map (String.trim >> String.toFloat)
    in
    case parts of
        [ Just r, Just g, Just b ] ->
            Just { r = r, g = g, b = b, a = 1 }

        [ Just r, Just g, Just b, Just a ] ->
            Just { r = r, g = g, b = b, a = a }

        _ ->
            Nothing


roundTo : Int -> Float -> Float
roundTo digits x =
    let
        f =
            10 ^ toFloat digits
    in
    toFloat (round (x * f)) / f


formatFloat : Float -> String
formatFloat x =

module NUI.Internal exposing (classIf, classes, cssVars)

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| `classIf True "x" == [ "x" ]`, `classIf False "x" == []`. Compose a class list
with `List.concat`.
-}
classIf : Bool -> String -> List String
classIf cond c =
    if cond then
        [ c ]

    else
        []


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute built from `--n-*` custom properties.
`initial` values (Naive UI's "unset" marker) are dropped.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"

module NUI.Css exposing
    ( css
    , element
    , layout
    , rootAttribute
    )

{-| Ships Naive UI's stylesheet and the scope marker it relies on.

The CSS is generated from Naive UI's own cssr sources (see `tools/`) and embedded so
the package is self-contained — no separate `.css` import needed. Every rule is
scoped under `.nui-root`, so an ancestor element must carry the marker class.
`layout` (drop-in for `Element.layout`) sets it for you, and `element` renders the
stylesheet node.

    view model =
        NUI.Css.layout []
            (Element.column [ spacing 16 ]
                [ NUI.Css.element
                , NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults [ Element.text "Hello" ]
                ]
            )

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute, Element)
import Html
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Css.Generated as Generated


{-| The full stylesheet as a string (for a `<link>`/inline `<style>` approach).
-}
css : String
css =
    Generated.all


{-| A `<style>` node. Include it once near the root of your app.
-}
element : Element msg
element =
    Element.html (Html.node "style" [] [ Html.text css ])


{-| The class the generated stylesheet is scoped under. Add it to (an ancestor of)
your components.
-}
rootAttribute : Attribute msg
rootAttribute =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.class "nui-root")


{-| Drop-in replacement for `Element.layout` that adds `rootAttribute`.
-}
layout : List (Attribute msg) -> Element msg -> Html.Html msg
layout attrs content =
    Element.layout (rootAttribute :: attrs) content

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorFocusPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorFocus
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorDisabledPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorDisabled
                            )
                  )
                ]

        borderVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                [ ( "--n-border", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", "none" )
                ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-border", cs.border )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", cs.borderHover )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", cs.borderPressed )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", cs.borderFocus )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", cs.borderDisabled )
                ]

        sizeVars =
            [ ( "--n-width"
              , if opts.circle && not isText then
                    height

                else
                    "initial"
              )
            , ( "--n-height"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else
                    height
              )
            , ( "--n-font-size", fontSize )
            , ( "--n-padding"
              , if opts.circle then
                    "initial"

                else if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.round then
                    paddingRound

                else
                    padding
              )
            , ( "--n-icon-size", iconSize )
            , ( "--n-icon-margin", iconMargin )
            , ( "--n-border-radius"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.circle || opts.round then
                    height

                else
                    borderRadius
              )
            ]
    in
    [ ( "--n-bezier", common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-bezier-ease-out", common.cubicBezierEaseOut )
    , ( "--n-ripple-duration", v.rippleDuration )
    , ( "--n-opacity-disabled", v.opacityDisabled )
    , ( "--n-wave-opacity", v.waveOpacity )
    ]
        ++ fontVars
        ++ colorVars
        ++ borderVars
        ++ sizeVars


customColorVars : Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
customColorVars maybeColor =
    case maybeColor of
        Nothing ->
            []

        Just color ->
            let
                hover =
                    Color.createHoverColor color
            in

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install Elm packages without going through github.com/zipball (which is blocked
# in this environment). Downloads the same source tarballs from codeload.github.com
# and unpacks them into $ELM_HOME/0.19.1/packages/<author>/<project>/<version>/.
#
# Usage:  scripts/install-elm-packages.sh [author/project@version ...]
#         scripts/install-elm-packages.sh            # installs the default set
#
# Respects ELM_HOME (default: $HOME/.elm-home).
set -euo pipefail

ELM_HOME="${ELM_HOME:-$HOME/.elm-home}"
VERSION_DIR="0.19.1"
root="$ELM_HOME/$VERSION_DIR/packages"

install_pkg() {
  local spec="$1"
  local author project version
  author="${spec%%/*}"
  project="${spec#*/}"; project="${project%%@*}"
  version="${spec##*@}"
  local dest="$root/$author/$project/$version"

  if [ -f "$dest/elm.json" ] && [ -d "$dest/src" ]; then
    echo "  = $author/$project $version (cached)"
    return 0
  fi
  rm -rf "$dest"
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  local url="https://codeload.github.com/$author/$project/tar.gz/refs/tags/$version"
  if ! curl -fsSL --max-time 180 "$url" -o /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz; then
    echo "  ! failed to download $author/$project $version from $url" >&2
    rm -rf "$dest"
    return 1
  fi
  tar -xzf /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz -C "$dest" --strip-components=1
  rm -f /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz
  echo "  + $author/$project $version"
}

DEFAULT_PKGS=(
  elm/core@1.0.5
  elm/json@1.1.3
  elm/html@1.0.0
  elm/virtual-dom@1.0.3
  elm/time@1.0.0
  elm/url@1.0.0
  elm/browser@1.0.2
  mdgriffith/elm-ui@1.1.8
)

pkgs=("$@")
if [ ${#pkgs[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  pkgs=("${DEFAULT_PKGS[@]}")
fi

echo "ELM_HOME=$ELM_HOME"
for p in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
  install_pkg "$p"
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install Elm packages without going through github.com/zipball (which is blocked
# in this environment). Downloads the same source tarballs from codeload.github.com
# and unpacks them into $ELM_HOME/0.19.1/packages/<author>/<project>/<version>/.
#
# Usage:  scripts/install-elm-packages.sh [author/project@version ...]
#         scripts/install-elm-packages.sh            # installs the default set
#
# Respects ELM_HOME (default: $HOME/.elm-home).
set -euo pipefail

ELM_HOME="${ELM_HOME:-$HOME/.elm-home}"
VERSION_DIR="0.19.1"
root="$ELM_HOME/$VERSION_DIR/packages"

install_pkg() {
  local spec="$1"
  local author project version
  author="${spec%%/*}"
  project="${spec#*/}"; project="${project%%@*}"
  version="${spec##*@}"
  local dest="$root/$author/$project/$version"

  if [ -f "$dest/elm.json" ] && [ -d "$dest/src" ]; then
    echo "  = $author/$project $version (cached)"
    return 0
  fi
  rm -rf "$dest"
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  local url="https://codeload.github.com/$author/$project/tar.gz/refs/tags/$version"
  if ! curl -fsSL --max-time 180 "$url" -o /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz; then
    echo "  ! failed to download $author/$project $version from $url" >&2
    rm -rf "$dest"
    return 1
  fi
  tar -xzf /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz -C "$dest" --strip-components=1
  rm -f /tmp/elm-pkg-$$.tgz
  echo "  + $author/$project $version"
}

DEFAULT_PKGS=(
  elm/core@1.0.5
  elm/json@1.1.3
  elm/html@1.0.0
  elm/virtual-dom@1.0.3
  elm/time@1.0.0
  elm/url@1.0.0
  elm/browser@1.0.2
  mdgriffith/elm-ui@1.1.8
)

pkgs=("$@")
if [ ${#pkgs[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  pkgs=("${DEFAULT_PKGS[@]}")
fi

echo "ELM_HOME=$ELM_HOME"
for p in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
  install_pkg "$p"
done

-}


type alias Rgba =
    { r : Float
    , g : Float
    , b : Float
    , a : Float
    }


{-| Parse `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `rgb(r, g, b)` and `rgba(r, g, b, a)`.
-}
parse : String -> Maybe Rgba
parse raw =
    let
        s =

    in
    if String.startsWith "#" s then
        parseHex (String.dropLeft 1 s)

    else if String.startsWith "rgba(" s then
        parseFn 4 s

    else if String.startsWith "rgb(" s then
        parseFn 3 s

    else
        Nothing


parseHex : String -> Maybe Rgba
parseHex hex =
    let
        expand c =
            String.toList c |> List.map (\ch -> String.fromChar ch) |> List.map (\ch -> ch ++ ch) |> String.concat

        pairs body =
            chunksOf 2 body
    in
    case String.length hex of
        3 ->
            pairs (expand hex) |> hexParts

        6 ->
            pairs hex |> hexParts

        _ ->

chunksOf : Int -> String -> List String
chunksOf n s =
    if String.isEmpty s then

module Main exposing (main)

{-| Foundation test suite for elm-naive-ui.

Runs without `elm-test`: it is a self-contained Elm application that evaluates a list
of named assertions and renders one DOM node per assertion
(`[data-test="pass"|"fail"]`, `[data-name]`, `[data-detail]`) plus a `#results`
container carrying `data-total` / `data-failures`.

`tests/inspect.mjs` loads the built page in jsdom, reads the Elm-computed results,
adds a handful of DOM-level assertions (inline `--n-*` style, classes, `aria-disabled`)
and exits non-zero if anything failed.

-}

import Browser
import Element exposing (Attribute, Element)
import Html exposing (Html)
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Button as Button
import NUI.Css as Css
import NUI.Internal as Internal
import NUI.Theme as Theme
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T


main : Program () () Msg
main =
    Browser.sandbox
        { init = ()
        , update = \_ model -> model
        , view = view
        }


type Msg
    = NoOp


type alias Check =
    { name : String
    , ok : Bool
    , detail : String
    }


eq : String -> a -> a -> Check
eq name expected actual =
    { name = name
    , ok = expected == actual
    , detail =
        "expected "
            ++ Debug.toString expected
            ++ ", got "
            ++ Debug.toString actual
    }


lookup : String -> List ( String, String ) -> Maybe String
lookup key vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( k, _ ) -> k == key)
        |> List.head
        |> Maybe.map Tuple.second



-- OPTION SETS ------------------------------------------------------------------


primaryOpts : Button.Options msg
primaryOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | kind = T.Primary }


roundOpts : Button.Options msg
roundOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | round = True }


circleOpts : Button.Options msg
circleOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | circle = True }


textOpts : Button.Options msg
textOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | variant = Button.Text }


textPrimaryOpts : Button.Options msg
textPrimaryOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | variant = Button.Text, kind = T.Primary }


ghostPrimaryOpts : Button.Options msg
ghostPrimaryOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | kind = T.Primary, ghost = True }


customColorOpts : Button.Options msg
customColorOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | color = Just "#ff0000" }


strongOpts : Button.Options msg
strongOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | strong = True }


disabledRoundOpts : Button.Options msg
disabledRoundOpts =
    let
        d =
            Button.defaults
    in
    { d | disabled = True, round = True }



-- CHECKS -----------------------------------------------------------------------


checks : List Check
checks =
    let
        light =
            Theme.default

        dark =
            Theme.dark

        common =
            light.common

        vLight =
            ButtonTheme.vars light

        vDark =
            ButtonTheme.vars dark

        customPrimary =
            Theme.setPrimary "#ff0000" light

        vCustom =
            ButtonTheme.vars customPrimary

        withFont =
            Theme.withCommon (\c -> { c | fontSize = "99px" }) light

        composed =
            Theme.withCommon (\c -> { c | lineHeight = "2" })
                (Theme.withCommon (\c -> { c | fontSize = "99px" }) light)

        filledPrimary =
            Button.cssVarsFor light primaryOpts

        filledDefault =
            Button.cssVarsFor light Button.defaults

        filledRound =
            Button.cssVarsFor light roundOpts

        filledCircle =
            Button.cssVarsFor light circleOpts

        filledText =
            Button.cssVarsFor light textOpts

        filledTextPrimary =
            Button.cssVarsFor light textPrimaryOpts

        ghostPrimary =
            Button.cssVarsFor light ghostPrimaryOpts

        customVar =
            Button.cssVarsFor light customColorOpts

        strongVar =
            Button.cssVarsFor light strongOpts
    in
    [ -- 1. NUI.Theme -------------------------------------------------------------
      eq "Theme.default == Theme.light" True (Theme.default == Theme.light)
    , eq "Theme.dark /= Theme.default" True (Theme.dark /= Theme.default)
    , eq "Theme.default.mode == Light" Theme.Light Theme.default.mode
    , eq "Theme.dark.mode == Dark" Theme.Dark Theme.dark.mode
    , eq "light primaryColor" "#18a058" light.common.primaryColor
    , eq "dark primaryColor" "#63e2b7" dark.common.primaryColor
    , eq "light textColor2" "rgb(51, 54, 57)" light.common.textColor2
    , eq "dark baseColor" "#000" dark.common.baseColor
    , eq "withMode Dark light == dark" True (Theme.withMode Theme.Dark light == dark)
    , eq "withMode Light dark == light" True (Theme.withMode Theme.Light dark == light)
    , eq "setPrimary overrides primaryColor" "#ff0000" customPrimary.common.primaryColor
    , eq "setPrimary derives Hover" (Color.createHoverColor "#ff0000") customPrimary.common.primaryColorHover
    , eq "setPrimary derives Pressed" (Color.createPressedColor "#ff0000") customPrimary.common.primaryColorPressed
    , eq "setPrimary Suppl == Hover" customPrimary.common.primaryColorHover customPrimary.common.primaryColorSuppl
    , eq "setPrimary keeps mode" Theme.Light customPrimary.mode
    , eq "setPrimary keeps fontSize" light.common.fontSize customPrimary.common.fontSize
    , eq "withCommon applies f" "99px" withFont.common.fontSize
    , eq "withCommon keeps primaryColor" "#18a058" withFont.common.primaryColor
    , eq "withCommon keeps mode" Theme.Light withFont.mode
    , eq "withCommon composes (fontSize)" "99px" composed.common.fontSize
    , eq "withCommon composes (lineHeight)" "2" composed.common.lineHeight

    -- 2. NUI.Theme.Color (values from seemly / Naive UI) -------------------------
    , eq "createHoverColor #666666" "rgba(126, 126, 126, 1)" (Color.createHoverColor "#666666")
    , eq "createHoverColor rgb(42, 148, 125)" "rgba(76, 165, 146, 1)" (Color.createHoverColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)")
    , eq "createPressedColor #666666" "rgba(90, 90, 90, 1)" (Color.createPressedColor "#666666")
    , eq "createPressedColor rgb(42, 148, 125)" "rgba(37, 130, 110, 1)" (Color.createPressedColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)")
    , eq "parse #0f0" (Just { r = 0, g = 255, b = 0, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "#0f0")
    , eq "parse #ff8800" (Just { r = 255, g = 136, b = 0, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "#ff8800")
    , eq "parse #ABC is case-insensitive" (Just { r = 170, g = 187, b = 204, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "#ABC")
    , eq "parse rgb(42, 148, 125)" (Just { r = 42, g = 148, b = 125, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "rgb(42, 148, 125)")
    , eq "parse rgba(1, 2, 3, 0.5)" (Just { r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, a = 0.5 }) (Color.parse "rgba(1, 2, 3, 0.5)")
    , eq "parse invalid -> Nothing" Nothing (Color.parse "not-a-color")
    , eq "parse #zzz -> Nothing" Nothing (Color.parse "#zzz")
    , eq "changeColor #666666 0.5" "rgba(102, 102, 102, 0.5)" (Color.changeColor "#666666" 0.5)
    , eq "changeColor rgb(42, 148, 125) 0.5" "rgba(42, 148, 125, 0.5)" (Color.changeColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)" 0.5)
    , eq "changeColor invalid falls back" "bogus" (Color.changeColor "bogus" 0.5)
    , eq "composite: transparent overlay = base" { r = 102, g = 102, b = 102, a = 1 } (Color.composite { r = 102, g = 102, b = 102, a = 1 } { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 })
    , eq "composite: opaque overlay = overlay" { r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, a = 1 } (Color.composite { r = 102, g = 102, b = 102, a = 1 } { r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, a = 1 })

    -- 3. NUI.Internal (pure parts; cssVars drop + classes are checked in the DOM) --
    , eq "Internal.classIf True" [ "yes" ] (Internal.classIf True "yes")
    , eq "Internal.classIf False" [] (Internal.classIf False "no")

    -- 4. NUI.Theme.Button.vars --------------------------------------------------
    , eq "vars(light).heightMedium" "34px" vLight.heightMedium
    , eq "vars(light).paddingMedium" "0 14px" vLight.paddingMedium
    , eq "vars(light).fontSizeMedium" "14px" vLight.fontSizeMedium
    , eq "vars(light).borderRadiusMedium" "3px" vLight.borderRadiusMedium
    , eq "vars(light).color" "#0000" vLight.color
    , eq "vars(light).waveOpacity" "0.6" vLight.waveOpacity
    , eq "vars(dark).waveOpacity" "0.8" vDark.waveOpacity
    , eq "vars(light) == vars(default)" True (vLight == ButtonTheme.vars light)
    , eq "vars(dark) /= vars(light)" True (vDark /= vLight)
    , eq "vars(light).heightTiny" "22px" vLight.heightTiny
    , eq "vars(light).fontSizeTiny == fontSizeMini" "12px" vLight.fontSizeTiny
    , eq "vars(light).iconSizeSmall" "18px" vLight.iconSizeSmall
    , eq "vars(light).textColorGhostPrimary" "#18a058" vLight.textColorGhostPrimary
    , eq "vars(setPrimary #ff0000).textColorGhostPrimary" "#ff0000" vCustom.textColorGhostPrimary
    , eq "vars(setPrimary).textColorGhostHoverPrimary tracks primary" customPrimary.common.primaryColorHover vCustom.textColorGhostHoverPrimary

    -- 5. NUI.Button cssVarsFor ---------------------------------------------------
    , eq "cssVarsFor primary --n-color = primary" (Just "#18a058") (lookup "--n-color" filledPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor primary --n-text-color" (Just "#FFF") (lookup "--n-text-color" filledPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor primary --n-color-disabled = primary" (Just "#18a058") (lookup "--n-color-disabled" filledPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor default --n-color" (Just "#0000") (lookup "--n-color" filledDefault)
    , eq "cssVarsFor round --n-border-radius == height" (lookup "--n-height" filledRound) (lookup "--n-border-radius" filledRound)
    , eq "cssVarsFor round --n-border-radius" (Just "34px") (lookup "--n-border-radius" filledRound)
    , eq "cssVarsFor circle --n-width == height" (Just "34px") (lookup "--n-width" filledCircle)
    , eq "cssVarsFor --n-opacity-disabled" (Just "0.5") (lookup "--n-opacity-disabled" filledDefault)
    , eq "cssVarsFor text --n-color" (Just "#0000") (lookup "--n-color" filledText)
    , eq "cssVarsFor text --n-border" (Just "none") (lookup "--n-border" filledText)
    , eq "cssVarsFor text --n-height (unset)" (Just "initial") (lookup "--n-height" filledText)
    , eq "cssVarsFor text primary --n-text-color" (Just "#18a058") (lookup "--n-text-color" filledTextPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor ghost primary --n-text-color" (Just "#18a058") (lookup "--n-text-color" ghostPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor custom color --n-color" (Just "#ff0000") (lookup "--n-color" customVar)
    , eq "cssVarsFor custom color --n-color-hover = createHoverColor" (Just (Color.createHoverColor "#ff0000")) (lookup "--n-color-hover" customVar)
    , eq "cssVarsFor strong --n-font-weight" (Just "500") (lookup "--n-font-weight" strongVar)
    , eq "cssVarsFor default --n-font-weight" (Just "400") (lookup "--n-font-weight" filledDefault)
    , eq "cssVarsFor --n-bezier = common.cubicBezierEaseInOut" (Just common.cubicBezierEaseInOut) (lookup "--n-bezier" filledDefault)
    , eq "cssVarsFor starts with --n-bezier" (Just "--n-bezier") (List.head filledPrimary |> Maybe.map Tuple.first)

    -- 6. NUI.Css.css -------------------------------------------------------------
    , eq "css contains .n-button" True (String.contains ".n-button" Css.css)
    , eq "css is scoped under .nui-root.nui-root" True (String.contains ".nui-root.nui-root" Css.css)
    , eq "css contains flex-basis bridge" True (String.contains "flex-basis: auto" Css.css)
    , eq "css contains .n-text" True (String.contains ".n-text" Css.css)
    , eq "css contains button wave keyframes" True (String.contains "button-wave-spread" Css.css)
    , eq "css is non-trivial (>50k)" True (String.length Css.css > 50000)
    ]



-- VIEW -------------------------------------------------------------------------


view : () -> Html Msg
view _ =
    let
        failures =
            checks |> List.filter (\c -> not c.ok) |> List.length
    in
    Html.div [ HA.class "nui-root", HA.id "app" ]
        [ Html.node "style" [] [ Html.text Css.css ]
        , Html.h1 []
            [ Html.text
                ("elm-naive-ui foundation tests — "
                    ++ String.fromInt (List.length checks)
                    ++ " assertions"
                )
            ]
        , Html.div
            [ HA.id "results"
            , HA.attribute "data-total" (String.fromInt (List.length checks))
            , HA.attribute "data-failures" (String.fromInt failures)
            ]
            (List.map renderCheck checks)
        , probeNodes
        , liveNodes
        ]


renderCheck : Check -> Html Msg
renderCheck c =
    Html.div
        [ HA.class "check"
        , HA.attribute "data-test"
            (if c.ok then
                "pass"

             else
                "fail"
            )
        , HA.attribute "data-name" c.name
        , HA.attribute "data-detail" c.detail
        ]
        [ Html.text
            (if c.ok then
                "PASS " ++ c.name

             else
                "FAIL " ++ c.name ++ " :: " ++ c.detail
            )
        ]


probeVarList : List ( String, String )
probeVarList =
    [ ( "--n-a", "1px" )
    , ( "--n-b", "initial" )
    , ( "--n-c", "" )
    , ( "--n-d", "red" )
    ]

                , Element.el (Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "probe-vars-empty") :: Internal.cssVars [ ( "--dropped", "initial" ) ]) Element.none
                , Element.el (Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "probe-classes") :: Internal.classes [ "n-button", "x" ]) Element.none
                ]
            )
        ]


liveNodes : Html Msg

    Html.div [ HA.id "live" ]
        [ Element.layout []
            (Element.column [ Element.spacing 8 ]
                [ Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "live-primary") ]

                , Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "live-disabled") ]
                    (Button.view Theme.default disabledRoundOpts [ Element.text "Disabled" ])
                ]
            )
        ]

module Main exposing (main)

{-| Foundation test suite for elm-naive-ui.

Runs without `elm-test`: it is a self-contained Elm application that evaluates a list
of named assertions and renders one DOM node per assertion
(`[data-test="pass"|"fail"]`, `[data-name]`, `[data-detail]`) plus a `#results`
container carrying `data-total` / `data-failures`.

`tests/inspect.mjs` loads the built page in jsdom, reads the Elm-computed results,
adds a handful of DOM-level assertions (inline `--n-*` style, classes, `aria-disabled`)
and exits non-zero if anything failed.

-}

import Browser
import Element exposing (Element)
import Html exposing (Html)
import Html.Attributes as HA

import NUI.Css as Css
import NUI.Internal as Internal

    Browser.sandbox

type Msg

type alias Check =
    { name : String
    , ok : Bool
    , detail : String

eq : String -> a -> a -> Check
eq name expected actual =
    { name = name
    , ok = expected == actual
    , detail =
        "expected "
            ++ Debug.toString expected
            ++ ", got "
            ++ Debug.toString actual
    }


lookup : String -> List ( String, String ) -> Maybe String
lookup key vars =

-- OPTION SETS ------------------------------------------------------------------

checks : List Check

    , eq "setPrimary overrides primaryColor" "#ff0000" customPrimary.common.primaryColor
    , eq "setPrimary derives Hover" (Color.createHoverColor "#ff0000") customPrimary.common.primaryColorHover
    , eq "setPrimary derives Pressed" (Color.createPressedColor "#ff0000") customPrimary.common.primaryColorPressed
    , eq "setPrimary Suppl == Hover" customPrimary.common.primaryColorHover customPrimary.common.primaryColorSuppl

    , eq "setPrimary keeps fontSize" light.common.fontSize customPrimary.common.fontSize
    , eq "withCommon applies f" "99px" withFont.common.fontSize
    , eq "withCommon keeps primaryColor" "#18a058" withFont.common.primaryColor
    , eq "withCommon keeps mode" Theme.Light withFont.mode
    , eq "withCommon composes (fontSize)" "99px" composed.common.fontSize
    , eq "withCommon composes (lineHeight)" "2" composed.common.lineHeight

    , eq "createHoverColor rgb(42, 148, 125)" "rgba(76, 165, 146, 1)" (Color.createHoverColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)")
    , eq "createPressedColor #666666" "rgba(90, 90, 90, 1)" (Color.createPressedColor "#666666")
    , eq "createPressedColor rgb(42, 148, 125)" "rgba(37, 130, 110, 1)" (Color.createPressedColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)")
    , eq "parse #0f0" (Just { r = 0, g = 255, b = 0, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "#0f0")
    , eq "parse #ff8800" (Just { r = 255, g = 136, b = 0, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "#ff8800")
    , eq "parse #ABC is case-insensitive" (Just { r = 170, g = 187, b = 204, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "#ABC")
    , eq "parse rgb(42, 148, 125)" (Just { r = 42, g = 148, b = 125, a = 1 }) (Color.parse "rgb(42, 148, 125)")
    , eq "parse rgba(1, 2, 3, 0.5)" (Just { r = 1, g = 2, b = 3, a = 0.5 }) (Color.parse "rgba(1, 2, 3, 0.5)")
    , eq "parse invalid -> Nothing" Nothing (Color.parse "not-a-color")
    , eq "parse #zzz -> Nothing" Nothing (Color.parse "#zzz")
    , eq "changeColor #666666 0.5" "rgba(102, 102, 102, 0.5)" (Color.changeColor "#666666" 0.5)
    , eq "changeColor rgb(42, 148, 125) 0.5" "rgba(42, 148, 125, 0.5)" (Color.changeColor "rgb(42, 148, 125)" 0.5)
    , eq "changeColor invalid falls back" "bogus" (Color.changeColor "bogus" 0.5)
    , eq "composite: transparent overlay = base" { r = 102, g = 102, b = 102, a = 1 } (Color.composite { r = 102, g = 102, b = 102, a = 1 } { r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, a = 0 })

    , eq "Internal.classIf True" [ "yes" ] (Internal.classIf True "yes")
    , eq "Internal.classIf False" [] (Internal.classIf False "no")

    , eq "vars(light).heightMedium" "34px" vLight.heightMedium
    , eq "vars(light).paddingMedium" "0 14px" vLight.paddingMedium
    , eq "vars(light).fontSizeMedium" "14px" vLight.fontSizeMedium
    , eq "vars(light).borderRadiusMedium" "3px" vLight.borderRadiusMedium
    , eq "vars(light).color" "#0000" vLight.color
    , eq "vars(light).waveOpacity" "0.6" vLight.waveOpacity
    , eq "vars(dark).waveOpacity" "0.8" vDark.waveOpacity
    , eq "vars(light) == vars(default)" True (vLight == ButtonTheme.vars light)
    , eq "vars(dark) /= vars(light)" True (vDark /= vLight)
    , eq "vars(light).heightTiny" "22px" vLight.heightTiny
    , eq "vars(light).fontSizeTiny == fontSizeMini" "12px" vLight.fontSizeTiny

    , eq "vars(light).textColorGhostPrimary" "#18a058" vLight.textColorGhostPrimary

    , eq "cssVarsFor text primary --n-text-color" (Just "#18a058") (lookup "--n-text-color" filledTextPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor ghost primary --n-text-color" (Just "#18a058") (lookup "--n-text-color" ghostPrimary)
    , eq "cssVarsFor custom color --n-color" (Just "#ff0000") (lookup "--n-color" customVar)
    , eq "cssVarsFor custom color --n-color-hover = createHoverColor" (Just (Color.createHoverColor "#ff0000")) (lookup "--n-color-hover" customVar)
    , eq "cssVarsFor strong --n-font-weight" (Just "500") (lookup "--n-font-weight" strongVar)

    , eq "css is scoped under .nui-root.nui-root" True (String.contains ".nui-root.nui-root" Css.css)
    , eq "css contains flex-basis bridge" True (String.contains "flex-basis: auto" Css.css)
    , eq "css contains .n-text" True (String.contains ".n-text" Css.css)
    , eq "css contains button wave keyframes" True (String.contains "button-wave-spread" Css.css)
    , eq "css is non-trivial (>50k)" True (String.length Css.css > 50000)

-- VIEW -------------------------------------------------------------------------


view : () -> Html Msg
view _ =
    let
        failures =
            checks |> List.filter (\c -> not c.ok) |> List.length
    in
    Html.div [ HA.class "nui-root", HA.id "app" ]
        [ Html.node "style" [] [ Html.text Css.css ]
        , Html.h1 []
            [ Html.text
                ("elm-naive-ui foundation tests — "
                    ++ String.fromInt (List.length checks)
                    ++ " assertions"
                )
            ]
        , Html.div
            [ HA.id "results"
            , HA.attribute "data-total" (String.fromInt (List.length checks))
            , HA.attribute "data-failures" (String.fromInt failures)
            ]
            (List.map renderCheck checks)
        , probeNodes
        , liveNodes
        ]


renderCheck : Check -> Html Msg
renderCheck c =
    Html.div
        [ HA.class "check"
        , HA.attribute "data-test"
            (if c.ok then
                "pass"

             else
                "fail"
            )
        , HA.attribute "data-name" c.name
        , HA.attribute "data-detail" c.detail
        ]
        [ Html.text
            (if c.ok then
                "PASS " ++ c.name

             else
                "FAIL " ++ c.name ++ " :: " ++ c.detail
            )
        ]


probeVarList : List ( String, String )
probeVarList =
    [ ( "--n-a", "1px" )
    , ( "--n-b", "initial" )
    , ( "--n-c", "" )
    , ( "--n-d", "red" )
    ]


probeNodes : Html Msg
probeNodes =
    Html.div [ HA.id "probes" ]
        [ Element.layout []
            (Element.column [ Element.spacing 4 ]
                [ Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "probe-vars"), Internal.cssVars probeVarList ] Element.none
                , Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "probe-vars-empty"), Internal.cssVars [ ( "--dropped", "initial" ) ] ] Element.none
                , Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "probe-classes"), Internal.classes [ "n-button", "x" ] ] Element.none
                ]
            )
        ]


liveNodes : Html Msg
liveNodes =
    Html.div [ HA.id "live" ]
        [ Element.layout []
            (Element.column [ Element.spacing 8 ]
                [ Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "live-primary") ]
                    (Button.view Theme.default primaryOpts [ Element.text "Primary" ])
                , Element.el [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.id "live-disabled") ]
                    (Button.view Theme.default disabledRoundOpts [ Element.text "Disabled" ])
                ]
            )
        ]

parseHex : String -> Maybe Rgba
parseHex hex =
    let

            Just 12

            Just 14

        'f' ->
            Just 15

        _ ->
            Nothing


hexPair : String -> Maybe Int

    case String.toList pair of
        [ hi, lo ] ->

    let
        a =

    in

    , g = chan top.g bottom.g
    , b = chan top.b bottom.b
    , a = roundTo 3 a
    }

createPressedColor : String -> String

        Just c ->
